title: Involutive matching partner map
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $M$ be a perfect matching of the complete graph on $2m$ vertices. The map sending each vertex to its unique partner in $M$ is an involution: applying it twice returns the original vertex.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching on the complete graph with vertex set of size $2m$
